# Distortion › Break

**What belongs here.** The image fractures into pieces or particles.

**Examples.** shatter, paper tear, disintegrate

**Family test.** Do the pixels bend, smear, glitch, pixelate or scatter?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
